title: Under the Golden Lanterns  (金色灯笼下)

segments.t: 傍晚时分，格雷厄姆擦亮的纸灯笼在庭院树枝间泛起温暖的金光。汉娜、伊芙琳女士和欧文举杯畅谈这一周阴差阳错结下的奇妙缘分。先完整听一遍吧。
Look up at those golden lanterns against the evening sky. How peaceful!
To think on Monday morning Caleb picked up the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.
If he had picked up the right bag, none of us would be standing here tonight!
My teacup survived, two brothers made peace, and Hannah found a new home.
Miss Evelyn, Caleb and I booked a quiet dinner nearby. Will you join us tomorrow?
Gladly, Owen, as long as nobody talks about selling old pianos!
And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!
We will bring half of City Hall to Tessa's tables next week, I promise.
Listen, even the buzzer from room four has been quiet all evening!
Do not tempt it, Miss Evelyn! I am almost fond of those two rings now.
Here is to the Linden Courtyard Inn, the loudest quiet place in Portland!
To good neighbors, warm bread, and open gates!
现在我们放慢节奏，逐句品味灯笼夜色里温情脉脉的祝酒与寒暄。
Look up at those golden lanterns against the evening sky. How peaceful!
'抬头看看暮色天空映衬下那些金色的灯笼吧。多宁静啊！' 这句里的介词短语
against the evening sky
并不表示反对，而是描绘金色灯笼以深蓝夜空为背景衬托出的美感。
To think on Monday morning Caleb picked up the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.
'谁能想到星期一早上，凯勒布在二号站台拎错了那只蓝色提包呢。' 句首的独立不定式结构
To think
用来感叹“真没想到”；后面用短语动词
picked up
指顺手拎起行李包。
If he had picked up the right bag, none of us would be standing here tonight!
'要是他当时拿对了包，今晚咱们谁都不会站在这里了！' 混合虚拟语气主句
none of us would be standing
对眼下今晚的情形作反向假设，感叹缘分妙不可言。
My teacup survived, two brothers made peace, and Hannah found a new home.
'我的茶杯完好无损，两兄弟重归于好，而汉娜也找到了一个新家。' 日常高频的固定搭配
made peace
字面意思是缔造和平，在家庭与朋友之间就表示握手言和、重归于好。
Miss Evelyn, Caleb and I booked a quiet dinner nearby. Will you join us tomorrow?
'伊芙琳女士，凯勒布和我在附近订了一顿安静的晚餐。明天您愿意和我们一起去吗？' 邀请别人同行共聚时，最自然礼貌的问句就是
Will you join us
亲切而不生分。
Gladly, Owen, as long as nobody talks about selling old pianos!
'很乐意，欧文，只要没人再提卖掉旧钢琴的事就行！' 条件连词短语
as long as
表示“只要满足某个前提”，伊芙琳女士笑着打趣往事。
And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!
'而且明天早上八点，各位的第一杯庭院咖啡由店里请客！' 餐厅或旅馆表示免费赠送、由店家买单时，固定用习语
on the house
是外出就餐极高频的好词。
We will bring half of City Hall to Tessa's tables next week, I promise.
'下周我们会把大半个市政厅的同事都带到泰莎的餐桌旁，我保证。' 句尾加上郑重承诺的短句
I promise
既是对客栈相助的回报，也让语气格外笃定。
Listen, even the buzzer from room four has been quiet all evening!
'你们听，就连四号房的呼叫铃这一整晚都安安静静的呢！' 现在完成时结构
has been quiet
强调从傍晚入夜一直持续到此刻都平平安安。
Do not tempt it, Miss Evelyn! I am almost fond of those two rings now.
'可别念叨它呀，伊芙琳女士！我现在都快喜欢上那两声铃响了。' 系动词搭配形容词短语
fond of
温和表达心里对某样熟悉事物渐渐产生了喜爱与依恋。
Here is to the Linden Courtyard Inn, the loudest quiet place in Portland!
'敬菩提树庭院客栈，波特兰最热闹的安静角落！' 聚会举杯祝酒时最经典的开场句式就是
Here is to
后面直接跟上致敬的人或地方。
To good neighbors, warm bread, and open gates!
'敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！' 顺着上一句祝酒词继续接力时，可以省去前面两词，直接用介词开头说出
To good neighbors
简练温暖地把气氛推向高潮。 学会了这些举杯祝福与待客之道，我们再完整听一遍整场戏。
Look up at those golden lanterns against the evening sky. How peaceful!
To think on Monday morning Caleb picked up the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.
If he had picked up the right bag, none of us would be standing here tonight!
My teacup survived, two brothers made peace, and Hannah found a new home.
Miss Evelyn, Caleb and I booked a quiet dinner nearby. Will you join us tomorrow?
Gladly, Owen, as long as nobody talks about selling old pianos!
And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!
We will bring half of City Hall to Tessa's tables next week, I promise.
Listen, even the buzzer from room four has been quiet all evening!
Do not tempt it, Miss Evelyn! I am almost fond of those two rings now.
Here is to the Linden Courtyard Inn, the loudest quiet place in Portland!
To good neighbors, warm bread, and open gates!
两兄弟言归于好，老客栈保住了未来，连四号房爱响两声的呼叫铃都在夜色里安静了下来。不过，老房子可还藏着最后一个大秘密呢！晚安。
Good night!
